0.text: Hello, you must be the new Guardian the town is in a tizzy over! My daughter told me all about you. Oh? But of course, we have yet to be formally introduced!

1.text: I am the dashingly handsome philanthropist, Marcell Cenn of the noble house of Cenn. Yes, I am of the Parathime descent, but let’s not hold that against me!

0.text: <c=lore>Parathime Canal?</c>
You’ve never been? Well, you are young. You will go one day I am sure. Parathime is the greatest country in all Täella-Oso!

1.text: Close your eyes and imagine it! Glistening sapphire streams of gorgeous water, channeling through a great canal. The city - fashioned with red brick and cobblestone roofs.

2.text: Upstream, the fresh water mixes and mingles with the colored salts of the great sea. The coast is ripe with millions of sunflowers all raising their heads high.

3.text: Can you smell it? On the air! The aroma of sweet roast duck seated on the finest china. In the distance… the bells of La’fure University chiming, chiming...

4.text: That is Parathime my young friend. My lady, my love, the blood pumping in my veins,  my one true home.

0.text: <c=lore>Sunflowers?</c>
Ah, is there anything more lovely than the Parathimian Sunflower? They are harvested, dried and cured to bring about the famed Parathime Cigar. A sign of wealth, power and nobility.

1.text: Alas, my friend, I am cursed with the heart of a poet, but the mind of a businessman. I saw the sunflower,  tasted of it's yellow smoke, and deigned to share it with all the world.

2.text: I beheld in my dreams a booming Sunflower trade, and so, with my inheritance - a single packet of seeds I began to grow my farming empire. Unfortunately those bourgeois bastards back home didn't see things my way!

3.text: And so here I am, in Patreayl, growing my lovelies and peddling my wares.

0.text: <c=lore>Poet?</c>
In Canal City, we have a saying “let love guide your lips, and daring move your tongue.”  Oh, how I miss my old life studying at La’fure University.

1.text: Digesting the literary works of Lifré, or the poems of Penthar… Ahem… “and I bent my frame below the green, saw dwelling ‘neath the blades of grass, the tiny folk who lived between the mighty meadow’s pastured pass.”

0.text: Ah yes to business I see.
Ah yes to business I see.
Why, she is the prettiest girl in the village. Her name is Bell and she is everything I am proud of about myself, as well as everything I wish I could have been.

1.text: Back in my younger days, they used to call me “the lover.” Hoho! Alas, not so much any more. White hair and wrinkles will do that to a man’s reputation. Oh, the women I’ve known. Tall ones, short ones, skinny ones, voluptuous red cheeked beauties....

0.text: I speak a good game, but honestly, my back has been giving me all kinds of problems as of late. I have been unable to get out there myself and tend to the Sunflower fields.

1.text: My farm is the largest around, follow the path to the South out of Highsteppe and you will find my lovely golden fields, or what's left of them.

2.text: I fear they may have been overrun by those pesky Redtails. Head over there and kill yourself a few beasties. There’s some Dram in it for you once you’ve cleared it out.

0.text: Keep your dear friend Cenn in mind when looking for things to do!
Oh, bless you, bless you $NAME. It appears my sunflowers will be safe for a while longer. How fantastic!

1.text: Listen, come and see me every now and then, I’m certain those damn Redtails will be back before I can blink an eye, and in those circumstances, my wallet will have need to pay you once more.

0.text: Goodday my noble Guardian, what brings you around?
The Redtails returned!
You’re not wrong there, my Sunflower guardian! Please, remove those pesky beasts before they completely destroy my crops!
Very well.
Fantastic! You do me a great honor. Here’s your reward. Come back and see me once those cocky bastards return!
Why hello $NAME, how have you been keeping?
I'm looking for a cigar.
Ah, say no more. Looking to indulge in the simple pleasures of Parathime’s finest tobacco? I don’t blame you my young friend.

1.text: Alas, my cigars are becoming harder and harder to produce in this dreadful, Redtail environment. You can however earn your stogie.

2.text: There is a man in New Kingsport - a representative of the Writers Guild, he awaits a copy of my latest poetry collection for publishing. Alas, I am too old, my back is too sore for me to present him with the finished manuscript myself.

3.text: If you could see to it that my poems made their way into his hands, then perhaps I would be able to part with one of my delicious cigars.

0.text: <c=pc>His name?</c>
You’ll do it? Fantastic! His name is Erin Von Leustron, you will find him most days in New Kingsport near the water's edge . Please, take my manuscript to him. Hurry!

As rare as they are now I would need a Redtails weight in Dram to part with one. I would rather have you do me the favor of delivering my poems, being published is something no amount of coin can buy.
What’s that? You had to pay him to publish it? .... But it IS being published isn’t it?

1.text: Oh thank the goddess. I'm sorry if I inconvenienced you in any way, friend. Here, take a Parathime Cigar for your troubles, I hope that more than settles our little debt.
